Card Q&A.q: When I had 3 security cards at the start of my main phase, I used this card's effect to return 1 card from my security stack to the hand which reduced my security stack to 2 cards. Does this card's "you may place 1 yellow Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait from your hand at the top or bottom of your security stack" effect still activate?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have 3 or more security cards, you may add your top security card to the hand. Then, if you have 2 or fewer, you may place 1 yellow Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait from your hand as your top or bottom security card.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
